devAccessEstimate: Same day for non-sensitive scopes (basic profile and email). No review needed to start developing.
productionEstimate: Three separate tracks depending on scope. Sensitive scopes: brand verification, Google's own published estimate is 2-3 business days. Restricted scopes: a security assessment, several weeks, no fixed number published by Google.

steps.action: Create a project in Google Cloud Console and configure the OAuth consent screen
If your app only requests non-sensitive scopes (basic profile, email), you can launch without submitting for verification
If your app requests sensitive scopes, submit for brand verification. Google's published estimate is 2-3 business days
If your app requests restricted scopes, complete a security assessment in addition to verification. This can take several weeks and Google does not publish a fixed timeline
Verify domain ownership in Google Search Console under a Project Owner or Editor account before submitting a restricted-scope verification. Missing this is a common cause of stalled reviews

blockers.description: An unverified app requesting sensitive or restricted scopes is capped at 100 total users and shows an "unverified app" warning until verification clears
A mismatch between the scopes requested in your app's code and the scopes configured on the consent screen forces the unverified-app warning, even post-approval

escalationPath: Google Cloud Console support, or the verification team's clarification questions sent directly on a submitted review. Resubmission is free but restarts the review clock.
